info.sub_name: 大學基礎英文(一)中高級

subTitleDesc.sub_describe: 藉由情境導向主題提升英語閱讀、聽力、口說、基礎寫作等語言技能

description.sub_name: 大學基礎英文(一)中高級
description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels. Different materials and diverse teaching activities were incorporated into course design to help students comprehend and appreciate texts, construct their own viewpoints, and communicate with their peers in order to develop basic skills in reading, speaking, and listening in English.

targets.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
targets.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend  gist, and analyze  important details and their logical relevance.

targets.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
targets.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
Classroom Rules / 課堂規範
1. Attendance & Punctuality 出席與準時
  • Be on time for class. 上課請準時到達。
  • More than 3 absences will lower your final grade. 超過 3 次缺席 將影響期末成績。
  • Late more than 15 minutes will be marked absent. 遲到超過 15 分鐘 視同缺席。
  • Notify the instructor in advance if you must miss class. 如需缺席，請事先告知教師。
2. Participation 課堂參與
  • Active participation is expected. 課堂中應積極參與。
  • Respect others’ opinions and listen attentively. 尊重他人意見並專心聆聽。
3. Assignments & Deadlines 作業與截止日期
  • Submit assignments on time. 作業需準時繳交。
  • Late work may lose 5% per day (or may not be accepted). 遲交作業每天扣分 5%（或不予受理）。
  • Follow the required format (word count, citation style, etc.). 作業需遵守規定格式（字數、引用格式等）。
  • No make-up quizzes will be given in class. 課堂小考不予補考。
4. Academic Integrity 學術誠信
  • Plagiarism or cheating will result in a failing grade and possible disciplinary action. 抄襲或作弊將導致該作業不及格，並可能接受校方處分。
  • Always cite sources properly. 請務必正確引用資料來源。
5. Classroom Etiquette 課堂禮儀
  • Silence phones and avoid distractions. 請將手機靜音並避免分心行為。
  • Be professional and respectful in communication. 請以專業且尊重的態度與師生互動。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Be on time. 請準時上課。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration.學生必須提前向學校提交請假申請，說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本，請勿使用複製版本。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本，以利上課活動使用。
6.  Students who need to take a make-up Mid-term or Final exam must submit an application within 3 days after the scheduled exam, in accordance with the university’s regulations. Students who are absent on the exam day and fail to apply for a make-up exam will receive a score of zero for that exam. Make-up exam scores will be subject to a 20% deduction according to the center’s policy.若須要期中或期末補考的同學，請遵照學校的補考規定，在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。補考成績按照中心規定，一律打8折。
7. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定，若作弊者以0分計算。
8.The extensive reading grade will be primarily based on the cumulative word count recorded by the Xreading system, accounting for 10% of the total course grade. For the high-intermediate level class, the target word count for the entire semester is 80,000 words. If a student exceeds the target by 10,000 words at the end of the semester, 1 bonus point will be added to the final grade, with a maximum of 5 bonus points allowed. Students may also consult with the instructor to conduct extensive reading through alternative methods, provided that the approach aligns with the principles of extensive reading and includes verifiable evidence of reading.本課程廣泛閱讀的評分將主要依據Xreading系統所累進的字數而定，並且佔總成績10%。中高級班全學期目標字數為80,000字，若學期末超過目標字數10,000字，得以加總成績1分，至多以加到5分為原則。學生可與授課教師協調，以其他方式進行廣泛閱讀、檢核其學習成效，但進行方式須符合廣泛閱讀之精神並有客觀閱讀之事實。
9. A TOEIC mock pre-test will be administered at the beginning of the first semester, and a post-test will be given at the end of the second semester. The test scores will account for 10% of the total course grade.本課程在上學期初會實施多益模擬考前測，並且在下學期期末時實施後測，測驗成績佔總成績10%。

Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.抄襲：必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.考試作弊：必須遵守考試規則，禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。

courseBankC.core_eng: Communication Skills：To be equipped with the skills of effective verbal and non-verbal  interaction  and team work communication.

courseBankC.core_eng: Critical Thinking：To be equipped with multiple perspectives and tolerance of differences to identify problems, engage in reflective and critical thinking to resolutions.
